fnol_text: My name is Esther Brennan and I live at 223 Primrose Close, Springfield, OH 45521. You can reach me on (555) 907-2701 or esther.brennan@example.com. On 7 November 2024 the Fenley Creek overtopped near our house after a week of storms. River water flooded the downstairs rooms and the garage. Policy HH-2023-00014. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Brennan on (555) 907-2701 to acknowledge the claim. Esther confirmed the loss date as 7 November 2024.
Site visit to 223 Primrose Close. Neighbour Anika Kowalski was present and confirmed the timeline.
Esther sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
